headline: Negrescu: Romania has passed the inflation peak. Annual rate could fall towards 5% by the end of the year
summary: Economic consultant Adrian Negrescu says Romania appears to have passed the peak of its inflation wave. He expects the annual rate could fall toward 5.5% in autumn and 5% by year-end, if fiscal policy adds no new price-driving measures.
why: Inflation trends influence central bank policy and interest rates, which affect Romanian government bonds and the currency.
